LanguageData.RMush_PoisonFlyAgaric.label: fly agaric poisoning
LanguageData.RMush_PoisonFlyAgaric.description: Confusion, drowsiness and impaired consciousness. High or repeated exposure can become life-threatening without sufficient care. Care must be repeated using the normal medical system. Recovery is gradual after stabilization. This poisoning's direct lethal check grants at least 24 hours after the first symptom warning. Other illnesses and injuries are not covered. Ordinary exposure resolves gradually; only high or repeated exposure enters the life-threatening course.
